created_for: PK-OS local assistant response SFT and evaluation

provenance.source: Manually authored from the PK-OS repository documentation and verified capability descriptions.
transformation_history: Questions and reference responses were authored for this dataset; no user conversations, personal files, or audio were collected.

Expanded v2 with 12 manually authored training records and 10 separately authored held-out records covering application dispatch, scoped file access, per-action approval, backend failures, diagnostics, recovery, updates, keyboard access, and build-tied acceptance evidence; no external sources or user data were used.

task_coverage: application dispatch and scoped file access
guest diagnostics and backend failure disclosure
known_limitations: Small manually authored response set; it is not representative of general user language.
This dataset does not train intent routing, structured extraction, planning, or tool selection.

The held-out set contains 34 independently authored questions with added coverage of permissions, recovery, updates, keyboard access, and evidence provenance. Topics intentionally overlap training; it remains a limited project-specific regression set, not a broad generalization benchmark.
Reference-token F1 is lexical only and does not establish semantic correctness or safety.
